title: Entitlement mapping and billing cutover orchestration for pricing consolidation
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Scope: coordinate entitlement mapping (old SKU -> new rate-plan units), define cutover windows and data migrations for billing, ensure backfill for invoices, produce segmented customer comms and sales enablement materials, and run end-to-end billing test matrix.
background: We are consolidating rate plans and renormalizing billable units to simplify SKUs and improve predictability. This ticket captures cross-functional runbook items required to avoid billing disruptions and to enable Sales and Support with accurate entitlements and messaging. This is not the work to change runtime enforcement; it is the cross-team orchestration to perform the datastore migrations, billing backfill, and external communications during cutover.
acceptance_criteria: All customer entitlements map to a new SKU or rate-plan without data loss for >=99.9% of accounts in the dry-run dataset
Billing backfill process produces matching invoice totals for the sample cohort and pass monitoring assertions
Sales & AE playbook published with objection-handling FAQ and entitlement lookup table
Support runbooks and console messaging prepared and validated in staging
Post-cutover metric dashboard and alerting in place (revenue delta, failed invoices, entitlement mismatch rate)
tasks: Finalize entitlement mapping spreadsheet (product + usage facets)
Lock cutover migration scripts and vet in staging (ENG-66321)
Run billing dry-run against 1k account sample, compare ledger diffs
Prepare segmented email templates and in-product notice drafts
Draft Sales playbook + objection handling + migration lookup table
Schedule canary cutover window and rollout gating conditions
Coordinate support rota for 48 hours post-cutover
rollback_plan: Abort and revert ledger writes; restore pre-cutover entitlements snapshot; disable new billing flags; run reconciliation job to reapply prior state. RTO target 2 hours for critical failures.
communications_plan: Draft customer announcement segmented by impacted tier (trial, self-serve, enterprise)
In-console banner + deep-link to FAQ on migration timeline
Email cadence: heads-up (7d), reminder (24h), post-cutover confirmation
Partner & reseller brief with migration lookup and entitlements CSV
sales_enablement: One-pager with top 10 customer questions and scripted answers
Lookup tool for AEs to translate old SKUs to new rate-plan IDs
Slide deck for enterprise calls with migration timeline and credit policy
support_playbook: Triage flow: entitlement mismatch -> entitlement-lookup -> manual credit check
Escalation matrix: Support -> Billing Ops -> PM -> Legal
Pre-populated responses for email and chat with tokens for account-specific values
Console diagnostic checklist (logs, ledger snapshot, entitlement mapping id)
qa_test_matrix: Integration: staging end-to-end billing job on sample dataset
Manual: invoice spot-check across 10 enterprise customers
Regression: ensure no change to runtime token accounting
